EmailTemplate.subject: What is the right patient billing approach?
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {{lead.First Name:default=Friend}},
There are so many options when it comes to choosing a patient billing and payments approach that making the right decision can be difficult. Is it sticking with what you’ve always been doing? Or is it throwing caution to the wind, embracing change, and going fully digital? Or should you be aiming for a more cautious, middle-of-the-road, hybrid model? Those decisions aren’t always obvious and can lead to massive consequences for your organization if you choose the wrong path.
Making the right decision that fits your organization's and your community's needs can be even harder when the vendor you’ve chosen to partner with turns out not to be a great fit. That’s why, looking for a vendor with a proven track record of client success (and not just one or two) is so important. Flywire works with 4 out of the top 10 largest health systems in the US and counts over 50 healthcare organizations as its clients.
Learn how we helped one of our clients, Banner Health <[[https://www.flywire.com/industries/healthcare/banner-health?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>, completely remodel their financial experience.
Best, The Flywire Team
